description: Expand motion component library with 15 new reusable animation primitives (HoverLiftCard, AnimatedTabs, AnimatedBadge, AnimatedButton, AnimatedTooltip, LayoutTransition, ScrollReveal, ScanningEffect, UploadAnimation, ProcessingSpinner, NumberTicker, ImageHoverEffect, EmptyState, FilterPills, StatusPill) in src/v2/components/motion/index.tsx. These components are the foundation for all subsequent screen enhancements.
steps: Read src/v2/components/motion/index.tsx to understand existing motion system patterns (EASE constant, useReducedMotion hook, existing components)
Read tailwind.config.js to understand available color tokens (brand, sage, terracotta, amber, danger tones) and shadow utilities
Add HoverLiftCard component: extends AnimatedCard with stronger lift (y:-6 medium, y:-10 high), props: elevation:'medium'|'high', maintains existing AnimatedCard API
Add AnimatedTabs component: sliding indicator using motion.span with layoutId, props: tabs:{id,label}[], active:string, onChange:(id)=>void, uses brand-500 for active state
Add AnimatedBadge component: status pill with scale entrance animation, props: children, tone:Tone, variant:'solid'|'soft', initial {scale:0.9,opacity:0}
Add AnimatedButton component: micro-interactions on hover/active, props: children, variant:'primary'|'secondary', disabled, onClick, hover shadow increase, active scale:0.97
Add AnimatedTooltip component: floating tooltip with AnimatePresence, props: content, children, placement:'top'|'bottom'|'left'|'right', scale+fade animation
Add LayoutTransition component: animated grid/list switch using AnimatePresence and motion.div with layout prop, props: mode:'grid'|'list', children
Add ScrollReveal component: enhanced scroll-triggered reveal, props: children, delay, direction:'up'|'down'|'left'|'right', more control than basic Reveal
Add ScanningEffect component: sweeping gradient overlay for AI processing visualization, props: active:boolean, can loop or trigger once
Add UploadAnimation component: drag-drop zone with scale and glow feedback, props: isDragging:boolean, children, onDrop, scale:1.02 when dragging
Add ProcessingSpinner component: premium multi-ring spinner, props: size?:number, tone?:Tone, concentric rings with staggered rotation
Add NumberTicker component: rapid digit flip animation alternative to AnimatedCounter, props: value:number, duration?, for dramatic reveals
Add ImageHoverEffect component: wrapper that zooms image on hover (scale:1.05), props: children, maintains overflow:hidden on parent
Add EmptyState component: consistent no-data UI, props: icon:ReactNode, title:string, description:string, action?:{label,onClick}, follows current card styling
Add FilterPills component: animated filter chip selector, props: options:{id,label}[], selected:string[], onChange, active pill has fill animation
Add StatusPill component: animated status indicator, props: status:'approved'|'pending'|'rejected'|'draft', maps to color tones, entrance animation
Add TypeScript exports for all new components at bottom of motion/index.tsx
Ensure all new components use useReducedMotion() hook and render final state immediately when motion is reduced
Ensure all animations use EASE constant and appropriate DURATION values from existing system
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes with no errors in motion/index.tsx
All 15 new components are exported from motion/index.tsx
Every new component respects prefers-reduced-motion via useReducedMotion() hook
Every new component uses EASE timing constant
Every new component matches existing code style and naming conventions
No runtime errors when importing any new component in a test view
verification: Run 'npm run typecheck' and confirm zero TypeScript errors
Run 'npm run dev' and manually import one new component (e.g., HoverLiftCard) in AIReviewView.tsx temporarily to test it renders without errors
Inspect motion/index.tsx file: confirm all 15 components are present and exported
Check that each component has useReducedMotion() check
Remove test import from AIReviewView.tsx after verification
findings: All 15 new components are implemented in src/v2/components/motion/index.tsx (1635+ lines) and exported as named function exports, matching the file's existing conventions: EASE = [0.22,1,0.36,1], the DURATION map (fast 0.22 / base 0.4 / slow 0.7), the shared Tone union and TONE_STROKE map, and a useReducedMotion() early-return that renders the final static state (no animation wrapper) in every single component. Verified with 'npm run typecheck': ZERO errors in src/v2 and ZERO in motion/index.tsx. A temporary usage file (src/v2/__motion_api_check.tsx) was created to instantiate all 15 components with the exact props from the spec, typechecked clean, then deleted — no view files were modified. Three defects found during review and fixed before commit: (1) AnimatedTabs used a hardcoded layoutId='tab-indicator', so two tab bars on one screen would share and teleport one indicator — now scoped per instance via useId(), matching the useId() convention already used by AnimatedModal and Sparkline; (2) FilterPills put bg-brand-500 on the button AND an -z-10 fill span behind that same background, making the specified fill animation invisible — the selected button is now transparent with an isolate stacking context, z-0 animated fill and z-10 label, plus aria-pressed; (3) ImageHoverEffect put whileHover on the inner wrapper so the zoom only fired over the content box — hover is now driven from the outer frame via rest/hover variants. IMPORTANT PRE-EXISTING BLOCKER (not caused by this feature, not fixed here): 'npm run typecheck' reports 71 errors across 19 legacy v1 files under src/pages/** and src/components/** (Queue.tsx, Sandbox.tsx, Sentinel.tsx, Trust.tsx, Feedback.tsx, Reassessment.tsx, Login.tsx, Shell.tsx, AnalysisPanel.tsx, BrandAssetsPicker.tsx, etc.). Cause: an earlier task replaced src/components/ui/Button.tsx with a shadcn-style API that dropped the icon/loading/block props and the 'xs' size that those legacy callers still pass (git HEAD:src/components/ui/Button.tsx still declares icon/loading/block/xs). Because 'npm run build' is 'tsc --noEmit && vite build', that unrelated regression currently blocks the production build; it needs its own fix task. Note also that src/v2/components/motion/ contains five unused, unreferenced leftovers (EmptyState.tsx, HoverCard.tsx, StatusBadge.tsx, UploadAnimation.tsx, DragDropZone.tsx) — nothing imports them and they duplicate primitives now in index.tsx; left untouched and excluded from this commit, they should be deleted once no branch depends on them.
